content:
Law enforcement was reportedly called to Jamie Foxx’s California home after a stabbing took place during his annual Halloween party over the weekend.

TMZ reported Sunday that deputies arrived at Foxx’s home in Thousand Oaks on Saturday after a man was stabbed in the neck and suffered a superficial wound amid the celebration. The event called Skvlk Fest is hosted annually by the actor’s 18-year-old daughter, Anelise.

Paramedics treated the victim at the scene and one man was arrested on charges of assault with a deadly weapon, according to the publication.

In a video shared by TMZ, multiple people could be seen handcuffed, and law enforcement officers appeared to escort hundreds of party attendees dressed in costume off of Foxx’s property.

It’s unclear if Foxx was at home at the time of the incident, TMZ added. The party was first set to take place Oct. 31 but was postponed due to inclement weather in California, Entertainment Weekly reported.

TMZ also shared an image of an event sign posted on Foxx’s property that stated guests were prohibited from having “real or fake weapons” as props with their Halloween costumes.

HuffPost has reached out to Foxx’s reps and the Ventura County Sheriff’s Department for comment.

Foxx has not appeared to publicly address the incident.

On Sunday, the event’s official Instagram account shared a recap from the evening, writing, “BEST NIGHT OF THE YEAR. Thank you all for coming to SKVLKFEST 2026! CANT WAIT for 2027 to see y’all again!”

Last year, Foxx called out a guest who apparently threw an object at rapper GloRilla when she performed last year.

“Why would you do something like that?” Foxx said on stage. “Why would you throw something at the stage, man? This is for free.”

“Y’all don’t deserve this shit. That’s fucked up, bro,” he added. “I’m so disappointed. I love y’all but hate whoever the fuck that was. That ain’t cool, bro.”
